description: This Java class 'GenericResultWaiter' provides synchronization and waiting mechanisms for asynchronous service results within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles receiving results or exceptions, tracking completion status, and waiting for service completion with optional timeout.

classes.name: GenericResultWaiter
classes.description: A class that waits for and retrieves the result or exception from an asynchronous service call, maintaining internal state.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Handles receiving a successful result from the service.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Handles receiving an exception thrown during the service execution.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status code of the service execution.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the service call has completed.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Retrieves the exception thrown during service execution, if any.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result map upon completion.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete and returns the result map, with a default timeout.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete with a specified timeout in milliseconds.
